_fixture: Invented video / karaoke / broadcast / microphone / display fixtures for the design prototype (Documents 03 §7, 15 §3–§5, 19 §4 'av'). No decoder ran, no caption file was parsed, no stream was sent, no microphone was opened and no display was probed: every frame count, bitrate, delay, level, offset and timestamp below is drawn so that components can show their states. Stage names and queue notes are local-only by design (Document 15 §4); nothing here is a real person or account. Track ids reference fixtures/tracks.json; route ids reference fixtures/routes.json.

follow.label: Video follows audio
follow.detail: Picture follows the engine's source position and tempo; a loop repeats the matching video interval. Key changes alone do not change picture speed.

independent.label: Independent visual
independent.detail: A separate visual plays on this deck; the audio crossfader and the visual crossfader are unlinked.

audio-only.label: Audio only
audio-only.detail: Chosen still or restrained app visual; no invented cover and no unrelated video is substituted.

D.reason: HDR (PQ) stream — HDR-to-SDR conversion is not handled on this device profile; the stream is rejected rather than shown washed out.

program.note: Program output is composited separately from the preview on this device.

karaoke._note: Stage names and queue notes stay on the device. Reordering or removing a waiting singer never replaces the active song (Document 15 §4).

queue.stageName: The Very Long Stage Name That Someone Chose On The Night

lines.text: Glass on the water, light on the line
We counted the harbour in four-four time

lines.note: No cue for this interval in the timed-text file

congested.label: Congested — video bitrate reduced within the profile
congested.policy: Bounded: reduce video bitrate, then frames, then reconnect, then stop with an alert. Latency is never allowed to grow without limit.

localFallbackRecording.note: Separate, user-selected option; needs storage and recording permission; not enabled because a stream failed.

permission.note: Microphone permission is separate in meaning from sending the mic to master, broadcast or ParDay.

none.label: No external display
none.detail: Program output stays on this device until a display is connected and verified.

wired-connected.label: Wired display connected · 1920 × 1080 · 60 Hz (reported, fixture)
wired-connected.detail: A clean program surface is ready to verify. Controls, cue, stream keys and singer notes stay on the phone.

wired-disconnected.label: Wired display disconnected
wired-disconnected.detail: Program output hidden. Nothing private was exposed; a reconnect needs a valid display configuration before it is live again.

wireless-unverified.label: Wireless display found · latency profile not measured
wireless-unverified.detail: Wireless display latency has its own profile and is not advertised as equal to a verified wired route.

verifying.label: Verifying display
verifying.detail: Checking resolution, colour range and a test pattern on the program surface.
